description: Header file defining the Setup class responsible for configuring and running build setup commands in the GN build system, including handling build directories, command line arguments, and build settings.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: Helper class to set up build environment, configure build settings, handle command line arguments, and execute build commands within the GN build system.

methods.name: DoSetup
methods.description: Configures the build environment for the current command line, with options to force directory creation.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the build setup process, including loading and configuration.

methods.name: GetBuildArgFile
methods.description: Returns the file used to store build arguments.

methods.name: set_fill_arguments
methods.description: Sets whether to fill build arguments from command line or file during setup.

methods.name: set_check_public_headers
methods.description: Enables checking of public headers after successful run.

methods.name: set_check_system_includes
methods.description: Enables checking of system style includes after successful run.

methods.name: GetDotFile
methods.description: Returns the path to the dotfile used in build configuration.
